settings.turn_help:
📘 How LAN QR, STUN, and TURN work:

1. Same Wi-Fi (QR Code / Short URL):
No TURN server needed! Start the LAN host in Match Setup — DeckBox automatically picks your real Wi-Fi IP (e.g. 192.168.x.x) and shows the short URL http://<IP>:8080. If the page doesn't open on your phone: (a) pause any VPN or pick the right Wi-Fi IP from the dropdown, (b) allow ports 8080 & 8081 in Windows Firewall.

2. Online over the Internet (STUN — active by default):
STUN (Google & Cloudflare) helps two PCs discover their public address for direct P2P connections.

3. When do I need a TURN server?
Strict routers or cellular networks (Symmetric NAT) may block direct P2P. A TURN server relays encrypted packets as a bridge. Enter free credentials (e.g. Metered OpenRelay, Cloudflare Calls) or your own coturn server here.
